title: IFRA strengthens fragrance safety dialogue with ANVISA
summary: Two days of technical exchange in Brasília brought together regulators, fragrance experts and industry partners to explore perfumery, fragrance safety and science-based risk assessment.

extraction.key_fact: 국제향료협회가 브라질 국가위생감시국과 함께 향료 안전성 및 과학 기반 위해성 평가에 관한 기술적 교류를 진행하며 규제 대화를 강화했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Two days of technical exchange in Brasília brought together regulators, fragrance experts and industry partners to explore perfumery, fragrance safety and science-based risk assessment.
